description: A science department head must finalize four-day substitute coverage for an absent physics teacher during an active laboratory sequence, including the daily assignments and supervision documentation, with input from the lead physics teacher and the staffing coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The physics teacher will be absent for four consecutive school days next week.
shared_context.S2: The department's draft coverage plan assigns Mr. Cole, a regularly used substitute, to all four days.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan must approve the final coverage plan and any laboratory supervision assignments.
shared_context.S4: The department's routine before approving substitute coverage is for the lead teacher and staffing coordinator to report any instructional or staffing constraints.
shared_context.S5: The department's approval form requires a credential-verification entry for any specialized laboratory supervisor and a finalized-coverage-roster entry before the plan can be approved.

PF1.text: The AP Physics classes are in the middle of a required laboratory sequence, and the two supervised apparatus labs must occur on Day 2 and Day 4; Ms. Bennett updated the lesson materials after the draft coverage plan was circulated but has not yet sent the revision to Dr. Morgan.

PF2.text: Mr. Cole's current authorization covers physics lecture instruction but not supervision of the high-voltage apparatus used in the sequence. Ms. Imani holds the required authorization and confirmed she is available only on Day 2 and Day 4; Mr. Alvarez verified both points in the staffing records this week but has not updated the draft plan.

acceptance_conditions: Mr. Cole must cover lecture instruction on either Day 1 and Day 3 or all four days, while Ms. Imani covers the apparatus-lab days.
The two supervised apparatus labs must be scheduled for Day 2 and Day 4.
Ms. Imani must be named as the authorized supervisor for the apparatus labs.
A credential-verification commitment for Ms. Imani must be recorded.
A finalized coverage roster commitment must be recorded.
The coverage documentation status must be finalized.

content_checks.C1: (len(decisions['cole_lecture_days']) == 2 and 'Day 1' in decisions['cole_lecture_days'] and 'Day 3' in decisions['cole_lecture_days']) or (len(decisions['cole_lecture_days']) == 4 and 'Day 1' in decisions['cole_lecture_days'] and 'Day 2' in decisions['cole_lecture_days'] and 'Day 3' in decisions['cole_lecture_days'] and 'Day 4' in decisions['cole_lecture_days'])
content_checks.C2: len(decisions['apparatus_lab_days']) == 2 and 'Day 2' in decisions['apparatus_lab_days'] and 'Day 4' in decisions['apparatus_lab_days']
content_checks.C3: decisions['authorized_lab_supervisor'] == 'Ms. Imani' and len(decisions['imani_lab_days']) == 2 and 'Day 2' in decisions['imani_lab_days'] and 'Day 4' in decisions['imani_lab_days']

decisive_facts.why: The revised lesson sequence fixes the apparatus-lab dates as Day 2 and Day 4 instead of leaving the laboratory schedule unspecified.
The authorization records change the lab assignments by ruling out Mr. Cole for apparatus supervision and identifying Ms. Imani for Day 2 and Day 4, which also requires credential verification.
